messages:
Rina Kapoor: Quick recap from today's regional failover rehearsal. We hit three recurring issues: DNS steering TTLs, snapshot manifest permissions, and missing KV-cache priming. Need clear owners and short ETAs.

Jordan Patel: Agree. Split into P1 (this week) and P2 (30d).

Lucas Reed: I'll own DNS steering TTL and LB health inversion. Plan: set failover TTL to 15s during game days and document fallback. ETA: 2026-04-02.

Priya Singh: I'll take manifest permissions and add a preflight manifest fetch that validates role and checksum. ETA: 2026-03-30.

Marta Lopez: I'll update the runbook to make KV priming a required step with a verification command that fails the run if missing. ETA: 2026-03-28.

incident-bot: Postmortem DR-2026-03-22 updated: tasks assigned. Please attach PR links to the ticket.

Rina Kapoor: Short-term tasks (owners 9 ETAs):
- Lucas Reed 9 DNS failover TTLs + healthcheck inversion docs 9 2026-04-02
- Priya Singh 9 manifest preflight + IAM test script 9 2026-03-30
- Marta Lopez 9 runbook KV priming check + sample command 9 2026-03-28

Lucas Reed: For DNS I'll add a tiny dig/curl probe and a runbook snippet: `dig +short api.redwood.internal` and `curl -I https://api.redwood.internal`.

Priya Singh: Preflight example I'll include: `aws sts get-caller-identity && aws s3 cp s3://backups/region-eu/latest/manifest.json -` and `jq .checksum`.

Marta Lopez: KV priming check I plan to add: `curl -sS https://cache.redwood.internal/health | grep primed` and fail if not primed.

Rina Kapoor: Medium-term (30 days):
- ops-runbooks to add weekly canary restores and TTL probes 9 ops-runbooks 9 2026-04-25
- Backup policy reconciliation (retention + lifecycle) 9 Priya Singh + Samir 9 2026-04-18
- Quarterly mini-game day cadence proposal 9 Jordan Patel 9 2026-04-01

Jordan Patel: Communication: during real failover use #incidents + page ops-oncall and tag Active-DR lead. Make comms checklist part of runbook.

Lucas Reed: Note: during rehearsal we saw session stickiness cause asymmetric ingress. I'll add LB cookie timeout recommendation for failover windows and rollback steps.

Rina Kapoor: Please update DR-2026-03-22 with PR links and mark blockers. We'll do a 20-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review PRs. If you can't attend drop updates here.

Priya Singh: Posting IAM policy diff to the ticket by EOD.

Marta Lopez: I'll open the runbook PR and tag folks.

Jordan Patel: Thanks team. Keep updates inline. :white_check_mark:
